title: Classification of strongly non-hyperbolic critical points of planar second-order chemical reaction systems
summary: The dynamics of chemical reaction systems with two chemical species can be described (under mass-action kinetics) by planar autonomous systems of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) with right-hand sides containing polynomials. While their behaviour close to hyperbolic critical points is well understood, their dynamics has not been fully characterized for strongly non-hyperbolic critical points, where the linearization close to the equilibrium is given by the zero matrix.
